crossCuttingFeatures.name: Mastery Gate / Parent Bypass / Exam Forecast
crossCuttingFeatures.note: Unresolved assessment findings remain red; corrective evidence can turn them green; next configured chapter/subject is blocked while prior chapter is red. Linked parents can authorize a specific bypass with password re-authentication and a recorded reason. Upcoming linked assessments receive bounded evidence-based forecasts and warnings.
